turns.content: My order #88213 arrived damaged and I need a refund today, I have a hard budget cap of $50 for any replacement shipping fee.
Acknowledged. Order #88213 damaged on arrival. I'm escalating to the refunds specialist agent.
I've looked up order #88213: it was a $129.99 purchase placed on June 2nd. Policy allows full refund within 30 days for damaged goods.
Decision: issuing a full refund of $129.99 to the original payment method.
Actually, instead of a refund, can I get a replacement shipped instead? I still need the item.
Understood, switching the resolution from refund to replacement shipment per the customer's updated request.
Checked inventory: replacement unit is in stock at warehouse W-12. Expedited shipping fee would be $65, which exceeds the customer's stated $50 cap.
Open question: should we use standard shipping (free, 5-7 days) to stay within the $50 cap, or request a one-time fee waiver for expedited shipping?
Standard shipping is fine, I don't need it urgently.
Decision: replacement unit for order #88213 will ship via standard shipping at no charge, ETA 5-7 business days.
